title: Improved Kissing Numbers in Nineteen and Twenty-One Dimensions
summary: We prove that the kissing numbers in 19 and 21 dimensions are at least 12460 and 31560, improving the best published bounds 11948 (Ho) and 29768 (Cohn and Li). Both constructions start from the odd-sign configurations of Cohn and Li, which leave room around the sign vectors they add. We use this room to reshape the added vectors so that codewords closer than n/4 can be used together.
